utterances.speaker: JUDGE MOLOTO
utterances.text: What does TAM stand for?

utterances.speaker: ANTE MARINOVIC
utterances.text: That was a factory that made trucks, and that was a company from Slovenia. That's where these trucks were manufactured. That was the name of the factory, the company.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MOLOTO
utterances.text: That's the model of the truck? Okay.

utterances.speaker: ANTE MARINOVIC
utterances.text: Yes, yes.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MOLOTO
utterances.text: Thank you. Thank you very much, Mr. Marinovic. Any questions arising, Mr. Black?

utterances.speaker: MR. BLACK
utterances.text: Maybe just one, I think very briefly, to clarify, Your Honour.

utterances.speaker: MR. BLACK
utterances.text: Mr. Marinovic, you mentioned something about Captain Dragan and training activities in Bruska. Were you present at the time that that was going on?

utterances.speaker: ANTE MARINOVIC
utterances.text: No, no. I was not. When people moved out of Bruska, then this Captain Dragan came and that's where they set up these training grounds and they were training their army there. I was not there. That was later. That was after me.

utterances.speaker: MR. BLACK
utterances.text: Okay. How did you hear about that? How did you learn that?

utterances.speaker: ANTE MARINOVIC
utterances.text: How did I learn that? It said Centre Alf. That's what it was called and that's what was written out there. How could we not see that? We saw it on video cassettes.

utterances.speaker: MR. BLACK
utterances.text: You mentioned something, a Centre Alfa, is that what you said?

utterances.speaker: ANTE MARINOVIC
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. BLACK
utterances.text: And what was the connection between Centre Alfa and Captain Dragan? How did you make that connection?

utterances.speaker: ANTE MARINOVIC
utterances.text: That's what they called it. Well, no, they -- they set this up. It was called the Scientific Centre Alfa. I don't know. That's what it was called. Then this Captain Dragan was there and that's where he trained soldiers, policemen, whatever he was training; I don't know. But judging by what we saw, this footage, you can see everything. Ask for it. You can see it.

utterances.speaker: MR. BLACK
utterances.text: Thanks very much. No further questions.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MOLOTO
utterances.text: Thank you, Mr. Black. Mr. Perovic?

utterances.speaker: MR. PEROVIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Thank you, Your Honour. I have no further questions.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MOLOTO
utterances.text: Thank you very much, Mr. Perovic. Mr. Marinovic, thank you so much for coming. You are excused, you may stand down, and thank you for coming to testify.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MOLOTO
utterances.text: Mr. Black?

utterances.speaker: MR. BLACK
utterances.text: Your Honour, may I also have permission to withdraw?

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MOLOTO
utterances.text: To withdraw?

utterances.speaker: MR. BLACK
utterances.text: To withdraw from the Chamber. I need to take care of some other business.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MOLOTO
utterances.text: You are excused, Mr. Black.

utterances.speaker: MR. BLACK
utterances.text: Thank you very much.

utterances.speaker: MR. WHITING
utterances.text: Your Honour, if I may, Ms. Valabhji is going to be handling the next witness, but I wanted to try to repair something that I think I did with respect to the protective measures. I should have been more clear that, in asking for closed session, we didn't need the other protective measures; that is -- well, pseudonym I suppose we still need, but the other, in terms of face distortion and voice distortion, those are not necessary once we have closed session. So if those -- and it just causes a hardship to the Registry to do all of those when we have closed session, so if I could just ask that we modify slightly the Court's decision so that those protective measures are lifted as being not necessary and that we just simply have closed session and pseudonym.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MOLOTO
utterances.text: Thank you very much, Mr. Whiting. Then the protective measures with respect to voice distortion and face distortion are lifted. The others remain in place. Thank you.

utterances.speaker: MR. WHITING
utterances.text: And then I think we need to go into closed session now to bring in the witness.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MOLOTO
utterances.text: [Microphone not activated] I beg your pardon, can I repeat that; I was not on the mike. May the Chamber please go into closed session.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MOLOTO
